name: @volter/twin-tinybird
description: Local Tinybird twin for the real-time analytics surface: Events API ingest (NDJSON/JSON, wait, schema-mismatch quarantine), typed Data Sources (create/list/get/truncate/delete-by-condition/drop), Pipes published from REAL SQL and executed by a deterministic ClickHouse-subset query engine with templating parameters, the Query API, the Tokens API with scope enforcement, and the Jobs envelope, built on @volter/world-core.
author: Volter (https://github.com/volter-ai)
